name: Landmark Regions Pattern
summary: Landmark roles identify the organization and structure of a web page by classifying regions into navigation, main, banner, and contentinfo.
rules: All perceivable content should be contained in a landmark region.
A page should contain only one primary main landmark representing the central topic.
If a page includes more than one instance of the same landmark role, each must have a unique accessible label (aria-label or aria-labelledby).

name: Navigation Landmark Pattern
summary: A navigation landmark designates a major navigational block of links.
rules: Use <nav> or role='navigation' for major site navigation blocks.
When multiple nav landmarks exist (e.g. main nav and pagination), provide distinct aria-labels.
Link text inside navigation landmarks should be distinct or have programmatically associated context.

name: Button Pattern
summary: A button is a widget that enables users to trigger an action or event.
rules: A button must have an accessible name derived from visible text or aria-label.
A button must be operable via both Enter and Space keys.
Do not use generic div or span elements for buttons when native <button> elements can be used.

name: Dialog (Modal) Pattern
summary: A dialog is a window overlaid on the primary page content, requiring user interaction.
rules: A modal dialog must contain role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'.
Focus must be trapped inside the modal while it is active.
Pressing Escape must dismiss the dialog and restore focus to the triggering element.

name: Link Pattern & Context
summary: Links provide interactive navigation to an external or in-page resource.
rules: Links can determine their purpose either from link text alone or together with programmatically determined context (enclosing sentence, parent paragraph, or preceding heading).
Generic link phrases ('learn more', 'read more') satisfy WCAG 2.4.4 if the enclosing sentence or preceding heading clearly establishes the destination.
When links navigate to new windows or non-HTML files, provide programmatic indicators.
